title: RuntimeClassBinding.v1
description: CTS-1: the decision binding a PurposeTask's declared abstract RUNTIME CLASS (from architecture/capability_runtime_classes.json) to a CONCRETE execution backend by policy + available credentials + provider health. Cloud-defer-only-after-local-equivalent: a cloud/K8s vendor is chosen only when credentialed AND healthy; otherwise the binding falls back to the class's BUILT local equivalent (is_local_fallback=true). Deny-by-default: an unknown class binds to the offline default backend (known_class=false). Produced by src/baltor/purpose_tasks/runtime_binding.py; pure + deterministic (all inputs injected). No truth is published by a binding; the FleetLedger remains the source of truth.

action.description: bind_cloud_backend = a credentialed+healthy class vendor was selected; bind_local_fallback = the class's local equivalent (or offline default) was used

runtime_class.description: the abstract runtime class that was bound (OCTS-portable id), or a marker like '(none-declared)'

backend.description: the concrete backend id chosen (a vendor id when bind_cloud_backend; a bare-id local backend when bind_local_fallback)

is_local_fallback.description: true when no cloud/K8s vendor was credentialed+healthy and the binding fell back to the class's local equivalent

known_class.description: false when the declared class is not in the vocabulary (deny-by-default → offline default backend)

reason.description: human-readable basis for the binding (which policy/credential/health condition decided it)

considered.description: the class's cloud/K8s vendor backends that were considered (after exclusions)
